name: probe_recurrent
title: Recurrent-channel probe: DeltaNet onset-vs-control separability
description: Onset vs same-trace control states in DeltaNet recurrent snapshots at REC_LAYERS [2,8,9,12,20], over 231 merged-corpus captures: pooled, within-trace (median 1.000 everywhere), and LOO AUROC per class x layer. LOO best at rec_L2: cycle 0.892, loop 0.859, muse 0.710 (n=9 traces). Rec channel real but weaker than residual (0.97-0.99); auxiliary.
caveats: conf=clear; muse n=9 traces — underpowered; rec rows exist only at onset + onset-anchor control positions.
